prompt: Draft a synthesis page for fixture pair Caching × Consistency that co-occurs in 6 pages across concepts/ and skills/.
expected_output: synthesis/ page titled A × B with Connection, Co-occur, Insight, Tensions, Strongest Objection (+ testable query), Open Questions, Related; mostly ^[inferred]; back-links from source concepts.
